author: Ari Koslow
title: Zack Gelof (hand) placed on IL
desc: The Athletics placed Zack Gelof on the injured list.
impact: Gelof had been hopeful to avoid a stint on the IL. He'll be down for at least the next couple of weeks after he had his hand stepped on in a game earlier this week. Alika Williams was recalled as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luis Arraez (foot) out of lineup Thursday
desc: Luis Arraez is not in the Giants lineup on Thursday against the Athletics.
impact: Arraez will miss a second straight game. He remains day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Emilio Pagan (hamstring) sent on rehab assignment
desc: The Reds sent Emilio Pagán on a rehab assignment at Triple-A Louisville.
impact: Pagan threw a live batting practice session earlier this week. He'll likely require a handful of rehab appearances before he is activated.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yosver Zulueta designated for assignment
desc: The Cubs designated Yosver Zulueta for assignment.
impact: Zulueta loses his spot on the Cubs 40-man roster. He'll head to waivers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brandon Pfaadt to start Friday for Diamondbacks
desc: Brandon Pfaadt will start on Friday against the Rays.
impact: Pfaadt has been building up in Triple-A. He most recently threw 52 pitches over 3 2/3 innings in his last outing. He'll likely be on a pitch count.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Rafael Devers goes deep in win over Athletics
desc: Rafael Devers went 1-for-4 in a 2-1 win over the Athletics with a solo home run.
impact: Devers continues a productive stretch at the plate, driving in runs in five of his last seven contests. The first baseman remains one of the more frustrating options as part of a streaky Giants lineup for manager Tony Vitello, slashing .239 with 12 homers, 38 RBI, and 36 runs scored through 79 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Victor Bericoto homers in win over A's
desc: Victor Bericoto went 2-for-4 in Wednesday's win over the Athletics with a solo home run.
impact: Bericoto has fought consistency issues at the plate of late, picking up hits in three of his last nine contests. The outfielder remains one of the more underwhelming options when in the Giants lineup for manager Tony Vitello, batting .227 with two home runs, two RBI, and two runs scored across 14 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Tyler Mahle steady in no-decision against Athletics
desc: Tyler Mahle allowed two hits and two walks while striking out four over 5 2/3 scoreless innings in Wednesday's win over the Athletics.
impact: Mahle was steady in his first start on the mound since May, allowing less than three earned runs for the first time in his last five trips to the mound. The right-hander remains a risky starting option in the Giants rotation until further notice, posting a 5.49 ERA and 1.46 WHIP with a 1-7 record and 2.4 K/BB ratio through 12 starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zach Thornton expected to be recalled to start Friday
desc: The Mets are expected to recall Zach Thornton to start on Friday against the Phillies.
impact: Thornton allowed four runs over 4 1/3 innings in his MLB debut against the Nationals in May. He'll get another opportunity following the trade of David Peterson.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Andrew Baker promoted to Triple-A
desc: The Rockies promoted RHP Andrew Baker to Triple-A Albuquerque.
impact: Baker posted a 2.25 ERA with 14 strikeouts over.0 innings for Double-A Hartford.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Gough promoted to High-A
desc: The Dodgers are promoting RHP Tyler Gough to High-A Great Lakes.
impact: Gough recorded a 1.33 ERA with 21 strikeouts over 20 1/3 innings for the Single-A Ontario.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Pierce George promoted to Double-A
desc: The Chicago White Sox are promoting RHP Pierce George to Double-A Birmingham.
impact: George recorded a 3.18 ERA with 27 strikeouts over 17.0 innings for High-A Winston-Salem.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Andrew Moore promoted to Triple-A
desc: The Padres promoted RHP Andrew Moore to Triple-A El Paso.
impact: Moore posted a 1.85 ERA with 45 strikeouts in 24 1/3 innings in Double-A.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Benny Montgomery retires from baseball
desc: Benny Montgomery has retired from professional baseball.
impact: Montgomery has decided to step away from the sport. He was the Rockies first-round pick in 2021.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Konnor Pilkington released by Tigers
impact: Pilkington will figure to seek another opportunity.
